Sudan's justice minister said amendments passed to the informatics crimes law tighten penalties for deterrence, and that a joint informatics-crimes unit is being formed among the competent bodies.

Sudan's Council of Ministers approved on 13 October 2025 a draft 2025 amendment to the Informatics Crimes Law, submitted by Justice Minister Abdullah Daraf, raising some penalties to seven and up to ten years and allowing electronic search and seizure of devices.
